description: In Manager.io (Northwind Traders business), you need to handle a procurement workflow. First, enable the 'Purchase Quotes' module via the 'Customize' settings (it is currently hidden). Then, create a new Purchase Quote for supplier 'Exotic Liquids' for 100 units of 'Chai' at a unit price of 15.00. Finally, use the 'Copy to' function on that quote to convert it into a Purchase Order. Save the order without changing details.
